τῆς διδαχῆς, ἐπεὶ παρεκτὸς Θεοῦ σε διδάσκει.–12–

τοῦτο ποίει. Περὶ δὲ τῆς βρώσεως, ὃ δύνασαι

mercy_translation.text:
See that no one leads you astray from this way of the teaching, for such a person teaches you apart from God.

If you are able to bear the whole yoke of the Lord, you will be perfect; but if you are not able, do what you can.

Concerning food, bear what you are able. But be especially careful about food sacrificed to idols, for it is worship of dead gods.

translator_notes: Direct Mercy translation from the Greek public-domain source.
The 'yoke of the Lord' is retained as the text's ascetical image; the food warning concerns idol-sacrifice.
